header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Muhammad Hashim Sairani advocate files Vakalatnama on
body: behalf of the respondent No.3 alongwith comments, taken on record. Learned A.A.G and counsel for respondent No.3 submit that the grievance of the petitioner is to be redressed by respondent No.11. Therefore, respondent No.11 is directed to hear the petitioner and redress his grievance within a period of thirty (30) days and submit compliance report through the Additional Registrar of this Court. In case the compliance report is not filed by respondent No.11, contempt proceedings shall be initiated against him. The instant petition stands disposed of accordingly.
A copy of this order be communicated to respondent No.11 for compliance.
